game_title: Stat Market – Fallen Statue Garden Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden, a garden of fallen statues: the spirit seeker must handle stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Stat Market: Use min(), max(), and sum() over a price list to make profitable trades.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden: a garden of fallen statues
core_gameplay_loop: In Fallen Statue Garden, repeat each round: Use min(), max(), and sum() over a price list to make profitable trades. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the profit value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about profit to power up the spirit seeker and open the ancient lock.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 8 (extended tier): Stat Market
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stat Market' (Week 7 slot 14), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Fallen Statue Garden'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how profit changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against stone sentinels in Fallen Statue Garden.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
